messages:
anna: Quick thread — planning the 6-email nurture/drip for the Dedicated launch. Need segmentation, high-level cadence, sample launch email + subject lines, and inbound lead routing. Goal is to move mid-market PLG teams from trial -> paid Dedicated. Thoughts?

josh: Segments I care about: 1) trial accounts with >100 daily tokens/requests, 2) engaged free users (weekly active), 3) churned trials (no activity 7+ days), 4) named accounts / enterprise leads (SFDC owner), 5) partners/integrations. Each needs slightly different CTAs.

liliana: Proposed cadence (6 emails):
- Day 0: Launch announcement + value props (Dedicated highlights)
- Day 3: Use-case deep-dive (PLG metrics we improve)
- Day 7: Benchmark story (latency & cost vs hosted) + case snippet
- Day 14: Technical primer + quickstart (1-click Dedicated demo)
- Day 21: Objection handling (security, SLA, migration path)
- Day 30: Sales invitation + limited-time commit incentive
Segment-tailor subject lines and hero CTA.

michelle: A few quick subject line options for Launch email:
- "Meet Redwood Dedicated — predictable LLM throughput for teams"
- "Lower latency, predictable cost: Dedicated is live"
- "Run LLMs on reserved GPU capacity — try Dedicated"
For partners/enterprise: "Private deployments & SLAs — Redwood Dedicated"
Also recommend 3 variants for A/B testing: feature-first, cost-first, and social-proof-first.

sam: Routing/ops notes: we should tag inbound leads by segment using UTMs + a header from the signup flow. Example UTM pattern: `?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_segment=trial_high`
Also add a webhook event to SalesOps when a user clicks the primary CTA and has trial > threshold so SDRs get hot leads immediately. Slack alert channel: #sales-inbound.

marco: For the A/Bs: test CTA copy ("Start Dedicated trial" vs "Talk to a specialist") and send time (morning vs late-afternoon). Also suggest we throttle send volume for the trial_high segment so Dedicated capacity isn't accidentally hammered during the campaign.

anna: Nice — action items:
- @liliana: draft email copy + 3 subject variants by EOD Thurs (include plain text + html snippets).
- @michelle: pick the 3 A/B templates and finalize hero creative by Fri.
- @sam: implement UTM + webhook; create SalesOps playbook for routing and Slack alerts (due Mon).
- @josh: define exact numeric thresholds for segments (trial_high etc.) and export seed lists (due Fri).
- @marco: coordinate throttling policy with eng-runtime and confirm limits (due Mon).

anna: Also: PR push plan — one launch email + 1 follow-up to engaged segment (week 1), and a separate product blog + benchmark post tied to email 3. We should include a short demo recording in email 2.

liliana: Will include the demo link + 2 short CTAs (watch demo / schedule a guided setup).

michelle: For the launch email copy draft — quick ask: use this subject variant for first send: "Lower latency, predictable cost: Dedicated is live" and hero CTA = "Start Dedicated trial". Will mock creative.

sam: FYI I'll add a small payload to the webhook with `user_id`, `segment`, `utm_campaign` so SalesOps can prioritize.

anna: Great — if nobody objects we’ll lock cadence and send list segmentation tomorrow morning, and plan the first send next Tues. :rocket:

josh: LGTM. Small note — include a note about canary rollouts for Dedicated so customers know we're pacing ramp-up.

marco: Agree. I'll add throttling and a soft limit for the first 48 hours.

anna: Perfect. Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a consolidated brief and a checklist in #marketing-ops.

(later) liliana: Uploaded first draft to /drive/marketing/dedicated-emails/draft-v1.html — feedback welcome.

michelle: Reviewed, left comments on subject line and hero.

anna: Good progress. We'll reconvene Mon morning if needed. :)
